candidates.working_question: 机器人应该对这个人说多详细，什么时候可以简化？
candidates.example: 请求被重复使用后，具体文字和指向动画逐渐简化为图形；遇到容易混淆的新请求时是否应恢复细节。
candidates.personalization_target: Individual demonstrated interpretation and interaction history, not age/nationality proxies or only self-reported expertise.
candidates.potential_value: Identify when brevity reduces burden while preserving actionable distinctions, and when apparent familiarity is misleading.
candidates.weak_version: Novices like more explanation, experienced users like less.
candidates.minimum_evidence: Interactive repeated task, equal learning opportunity, held-out requests/context, interpretation/action measures separate from liking.
baselines_to_consider: Personalized policy with a justified learning signal
candidates.fast_check: Does individual history predict interpretation of new instances beyond current context and a good fixed design?
candidates.stop_or_reframe: If simple fixed or user-selected detail solves the problem and no substantive boundary remains, avoid building an adaptive system solely for personalization.
candidates.feasibility: Relatively high conditional on reusable interactive platform; material validity remains a substantial cost.
candidates.relationship_boundary: Supports interpretation and short-term expectations; no relationship improvement inference.

candidates.working_question: 机器人没有得到回应时，应该继续提醒，还是退让？
candidates.example: 机器人请求挪开物品；用户没有回应，可能没注意、误解、正在忙或选择不回应。
candidates.personalization_target: Individual response preferences and habits distinguished from experimentally controlled urgency and current workload.
candidates.potential_value: Resolve the trade-off between noticeable, understandable requests and unwanted response pressure; study the costs of treating silence as a learning signal.
candidates.weak_version: People prefer fewer interruptions when busy.
candidates.existing_foundation: Manicule records suggest response obligation/social pressure as a qualitative lead; no review text or raw-data reanalysis performed here.
candidates.minimum_evidence: Real main task plus robot requests with reliable timing; record missed requests, appropriate response, deliberate deferral, main-task cost and perceived pressure.
baselines_to_consider: Personal policy where history adds justified information
candidates.fast_check: Can observed behavior distinguish failed communication from deliberate nonresponse? Does personal history add useful information beyond the situation?
candidates.stop_or_reframe: If effects are entirely workload/urgency effects, reframe as contextual expression design rather than claiming individual personalization.
candidates.feasibility: Relatively high to medium with interactive VR/desktop; automatic sensing is not needed to first establish the phenomenon.
candidates.relationship_boundary: Short-term pressure, autonomy and expectations are measurable; persistent respect or relationship change requires further appropriate repeated-use evidence.

candidates.working_question: 人和机器人能否形成双方逐渐约定的视觉简写？
candidates.example: 多次共同任务后，一段完整动画被双方确认的短动作替代；新任务或换搭档时检验它是否仍被理解。
candidates.personalization_target: Dyad-specific agreed meaning and shared interaction history, rather than aesthetic preference alone.
candidates.potential_value: Separate shared-history effects from mere repeated exposure and examine the trade-off between local efficiency and transferability.
candidates.weak_version: Repeatedly teach assigned icons and show faster recognition.
candidates.minimum_evidence: Actual negotiation/confirmation/repair, matched-exposure comparison, and transfer or partner manipulation when partner specificity is claimed.
candidates.fast_check: Do participants actually negotiate and reuse expressions, or only memorize assigned cues?
candidates.stop_or_reframe: If the task only elicits memorization, do not describe it as co-constructed convention.
candidates.feasibility: Medium to lower: controlled repetition is possible, but interaction design, exposure matching and repeated participation add cost.
candidates.relationship_boundary: Efficient dyad communication or perceived familiarity is not by itself attachment or relationship quality.

candidates.working_question: 机器人个性化错了，怎样让用户看得出来并纠正？
candidates.example: 用户今天没回应，机器人把它学成永久少提醒；用户需要说明只限今天或撤销这次学习。
candidates.personalization_target: Scope, duration and correction of learned visual-expression preferences.
candidates.potential_value: Study how users recognize and repair a robot's mistaken interpretation of their behavior, including temporary versus durable updates.
candidates.weak_version: Add a settings button and show higher perceived control.
candidates.minimum_evidence: Plausible bounded adaptation errors; compare fair recovery mechanisms and assess error recurrence, recovery effort and subsequent interaction.
baselines_to_consider: A credible automatic policy with matched performance
candidates.fast_check: Can users identify what changed and correct the intended scope without excessive work?
candidates.stop_or_reframe: If a generic notification/settings UI answers the whole question, strengthen or reconsider the substantive robot-expression bridge.
candidates.feasibility: Medium: a small inspectable state model can suffice before a complex learning system.
candidates.relationship_boundary: Recovery and control can be studied directly; restored trust or relationship quality requires its own evidence.

candidates.working_question: 怎样帮助用户或设计者创作适合特定人的机器人表达？
candidates.example: 创作者希望表达一个不紧急、可以稍后处理的请求，工具支持预览与检查，而不只是选择颜色和动画。
candidates.personalization_target: Explicit recipient-specific communication constraints and creative intent; creator and target recipient must be distinguished.
candidates.potential_value: Enable valuable expressions that creators cannot currently produce or verify efficiently, with separate recipient interpretation checks when communicative success is claimed.
candidates.weak_version: Build an editor or LLM generator and collect satisfaction ratings.
candidates.minimum_evidence: Actual creator need and task; credible simple-tool comparison; effort, errors and achieved capability; independent target-recipient evidence for intended meaning claims.
baselines_to_consider: Existing programming/animation workflow appropriate to the task
candidates.fast_check: Identify repeated real creation failures before implementing a complete editor.
candidates.stop_or_reframe: If no recurring creator difficulty exists or simple templates already solve it, defer the full tool.
candidates.feasibility: Conditional medium; high development-overrun risk without a bounded validated need.
candidates.relationship_boundary: Creator investment, aesthetics and recipient interpretation must not be conflated with relationship improvement.

sources.title: Adaptive Interaction of Persistent Robots to User Temporal Preferences
sources.access: Full PDF available; targeted abstract/introduction and method framing checked, not a full audit
sources.source_says: Models temporal preferences and learning over fixed interaction options; light animations on CoBot motivate personalization.
sources.boundary: Does not establish that personalized communicative meaning or long-term relationships improve.

sources.title: Learning to Communicate Functional States with Nonverbal Expressions for Improved Human-Robot Collaboration
sources.source_says: Learns nonverbal auditory expression parameters from human feedback; reports a 24-participant study.
sources.boundary: AUDITORY, not visual: cross-modal method precedent only; no causal relationship claim.

sources.title: How People Envision Robot Interruption Behaviors
sources.access: Publisher abstract indexed by search; direct open failed
sources.source_says: 18-participant embodied elicitation/interview study across task and urgency scenarios; reports differing expectations for low-urgency interruption and robot role.
sources.boundary: Elicited expectations do not establish adaptive-policy benefit or stable personal preferences.

sources.title: SPOTTER: A Framework for Investigating Convention Formation in a Visually Grounded Human-Robot Reference Task
sources.access: Official paper abstract and targeted PDF abstract/introduction; also existing local paper object x1-spotter-human-robot-conventions
sources.source_says: Exploratory Dutch reference tasks yield stable conventions without shortening referring-expression length in HRI.
sources.boundary: Spoken referring expressions over visual scenes, not robot visual-output shorthand; no absence or automatic transfer claim.

sources.title: Communicating Robot Conventions through Shared Autonomy
sources.source_says: Robot motion reveals its chosen control convention; comparisons include unaided learning and written instructions.
sources.boundary: Control convention demonstration is not equivalent to jointly negotiated visual language.

sources.title: Nonverbal Robot Feedback for Human Teachers
sources.source_says: Robot nonverbal feedback exposes its current estimate of human preferences to aid human teaching and understanding of the learner.
sources.boundary: Visibility of learned preferences has precedent; candidate correction-scope question still needs closest-work validation.

sources.title: Balancing User Control and Perceived Robot Social Agency through the Design of End-User Robot Programming Interfaces
sources.access: Indexed author PDF abstract; direct PDF open failed. Author/lab publication listing verified.
sources.source_says: Examines granularity of end-user programming and trade-offs between user control and perceived social agency.
sources.boundary: Do not infer that customization universally improves relationships or that a new settings interface alone is novel.

sources.title: End-User Puppeteering of Expressive Movements
sources.access: Author abstract; workshop extended abstract, latest revision 2023
sources.source_says: Explores end-user puppeteering of expressive movement with immediate feedback.
sources.boundary: Preliminary authoring precedent, not definitive evaluation of recipient-specific semantic authoring.
